messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 1802345678 — P1: autoscale controller appears to be stalled in us-west-2; GPU queue growth >10k, request throttling observed. Paging @matt_oncall and SRE rotation. Details: autoscaler losing leader lease + frequent scale failures.

matt_oncall: on it. acked page. gathering logs and current queue sizes. any immediate customer-facing impact?

sara_sre: customer-facing: a handful of customers reporting 503s and high tail latency for generation endpoints. Support ticket #CS-1129 escalating. ETA to mitigate?

matt_oncall: initial triage: autoscale controller logs show repeated leader-election / reconcile loops. scale attempts show "rejected: capacity limit" even though metric-based desired replicas > max. suspect controller stuck on cached maxReplicas value.

jia_runtime: pinging runtime team — we saw surge from batched inference earlier around 03:10UTC, probably pushed metrics. controller should have scaled but kept hitting cooldown and an API error: 429 from cloud provider when requesting new instances.

kevin_infra: cloud console shows ASG in ERROR state in us-west-2b, quota for GPU instances is at limit. Looks like pool max is 40, desired tried to go to 60. Quota prevents provisioning.

matt_oncall: plan A: temporarily increase dedicated burst pool by manually spinning up 6 GPU instances (low-priority) to relieve queue. Plan B: if quota blocks, evac low-priority jobs and enable synthetic throttling for non-critical routes. Who can run manual resize?

kevin_infra: I can run manual resize, requesting +6 g4dn. Will open cloud quota request but that takes time. Executing manual provisioning now.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: manual scaling run by kevin_infra started at 1802345710.

kevin_infra: ran: 
```
aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name redwood-gpu-usw2-pool --desired-capacity 46 --region us-west-2
```
New instances provisioning; warming.

jia_runtime: while nodes spin up, enabling conservative routing: route tier-2 customers to lower-cost model and enable prefix caching for repeated hot prompts. Patching routing policy now.

matt_oncall: also toggled autoscaler off-to-standby to prevent it from fighting manual changes: 
```
kubectl patch deployment gpu-autoscaler -n infra --patch '{"spec":{"replicas":0}}'
```
(we'll restore once cloud quota and controller fix are verified)

sara_sre: CS update sent: "We are actively mitigating a GPU provisioning issue causing higher latencies and throttles; teams are being routed and we are bringing up extra capacity. We'll follow up with timeline and postmortem." :white_check_mark:

emily_cs: copying major impacted customers; they want ETA. Please confirm when queue < 1k and 99p latency < 5s before I update.

matt_oncall: watching queue: 10:20UTC queue=12,400; 10:24UTC queue=7,900 (nodes still initializing).

kevin_infra: instances are healthy and joined the pool at 10:27UTC. Cloud errors: "RequestLimitExceeded" seen earlier; raised quota ticket but manual provisioning succeeded because we used spot fallback.

jia_runtime: routing changes in effect. telemetry shows reduced incoming token rate to heavy models.

matt_oncall: queue now 1,100 at 10:33UTC; starting to drain. throttling reduced.

incident-bot: system: alert suppression applied for autoscaler noisy-errors while manual mitigation in progress.

kevin_infra: note: controller logs snippet: 
```
E 03:11:42 autoscaler.go:421 leader election lost: context canceled
W 03:11:45 reconcile.go:89 reconcile failed: desiredReplicas 62 > maxReplicas 40, rejecting
E 03:11:50 cloudapi.go:312 allocation error: RequestLimitExceeded
```

matt_oncall: root cause hypothesis: quota exhaustion + autoscale controller failing to reconcile after transient cloud API 429s, causing cooldown/backoff state and rejecting further scale attempts. Controller also cached an old maxReplicas and didn't pick up manual pool increase because of leader-election churn.

jia_runtime: mitigation summary (what we did):
- manual pool resize + spot fallback (+6 GPUs)
- autoscaler put in standby / reconciled manually
- routing to lower-cap models for non-critical customers
- suppressed noisy alerts to reduce pager churn
- CS notifications sent

sara_sre: impact summary: ~17 minutes of elevated latencies and soft 503s for a subset of customers (mainly heavy batch jobs). No persistent data loss. CS ticket created and owners notified.

matt_oncall: follow-ups / action items we should capture for postmortem:
1) increase GPU quota in us-west-2 and pre-authorize rapid emergency increases (kevin_infra)
2) autoscaler hardening: handle cloud API 429s gracefully and avoid caching stale maxReplicas across leader elections (jia_runtime)
3) add synthetic smoke that attempts small scale-ups and validates desired vs observed replica counts (sre)
4) improve alerting: separate 'scale-rejected' noisy errors from real capacity exhaustion pages (sara_sre)
5) run a chaos test for quota/leader-election failures during non-peak hours (eng)

kevin_infra: owning item 1 and starting quota request now. Will draft emergency runbook for manual pool expansion.

jia_runtime: owning item 2. I'll open an RFC for autoscaler change and a short-term patch to ignore cached maxReplicas if reconciliation sees conflicting ASG state.

sara_sre: I'll update alerts and own postmortem doc. assigning to jia_runtime as PM for the postmortem write-up. Target doc draft by EOD tomorrow.

emily_cs: thanks team — I'll keep customers updated. Please ping me in this thread when we hit queue < 500 and 99p latency < 3s.

matt_oncall: final checks: queue 380 at 10:41UTC, 99p latency back to 2.7s. Marking incident mitigated at 10:42UTC. Moving to post-incident phase.

incident-bot: INCIDENT 1802345678 update — mitigated at 1802345762, severity lowered. Postmortem owner: jia_runtime.

matt_oncall: thanks everyone. I'll hand over to jia for postmortem. Closing on-call handoff.

jia_runtime: copying notes into postmortem doc now, will include timelines, root cause analysis, and action owners.

sara_sre: leaving this thread open until doc ready. :spiral_note_pad:
